# Create Oncoprint for Targeted Sequencing data 
based on `Oncoprint` from the [ComplexHeatmap](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ComplexHeatmap.html) package.

### 1. Select genes of interest for visualization
Can be selected for various reasons e.g. frequency, GOI
```{r GOI}
```

### 2. Create annotation for oncoprint visualization 
```{r onco-ann, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

anno <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/ccRCC/Metadaten_RCC/04_ccRCC_IHC_Mut/PBRM1_BAP1_SETD2_mutations_ccRCC_panel.xlsx")) 
anno <- anno %>% select(Tumor,Chromosome) %>% distinct()

#continous scales 
#col_TVF = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#A50026","#FFFFBF", "#006837"))

#discrete scales
col = list(Chromosome = c("#EFC000FF")
)

col_list_1 = foreach(i=1:1) %do% {
  color= col[[i]]
  names(color)= sort(unique(anno[,names(col)[i]]))
  color
}

names(col_list_1) <- c(names(col))

ha = HeatmapAnnotation(#Tumor = anno$Tumor,
                       Chromosome = anno$Chromosome,
                       #TVF = anno$TumorVariantFrequency,
                       col = col_list_1
                       )
```

### 3. Matrix for each alteration type and combine in binary list
Prepare a list of binary matrices. Each matrix is named like the genomic alteration
rows = gene in gene list, columns = patients/samples, value = 1 -> mutation is present

```{r binary mat, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- read_xlsx("/Users/lasmey/Desktop/ccRCC/Metadaten_RCC/04_ccRCC_IHC_Mut/PBRM1_BAP1_SETD2_mutations_ccRCC_panel.xlsx") 
snv <- snv %>% select(Tumor, Gene) %>% mutate(mut_level = str_split(snv$SnpEff_Annotation,"\\|",simplify = T)[,2]) 
snv <- snv %>% mutate(mut_level = str_split(snv$mut_level,"&",simplify = T)[,1])

mut_levels_for_matrix = snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()
gene_list = snv %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list_new = list()
placeholder_gene = gene_list[1]
pids = unique(snv$Tumor)
placeholder_pid = pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level
  x = snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Gene %in% gene_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", gene_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Gene) |       #allow for multi-gene mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", gene_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Gene) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(Tumor, Gene) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x = x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Gene, value)
    
    #transpose
    y = dplyr::select(x, -Tumor) 
    
    rownames(y) = x$Tumor
    y = t(y)
    
    #replace NA by 0
    y[is.na(y)] = 0
  }else{
    y = tibble(0)
    colnames(y) = placeholder_pid
    row.names(y) = placeholder_gene
  }
  
  mut_list_new[[mut]] = as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list2 = unify_mat_list(mut_list_new)
```

### 4. Print Oncoprint

```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.width=12,fig.height=6}
# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
ord= anno$Tumor

# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list2)){
  dif_gen= setdiff(gene_list,rownames(mut_list2[[i]]))
  dif_pat= setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list2[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list2[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list2[[i]])
  mut_list2[[i]]=cbind(mut_list2[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list2[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list2[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list2[[i]]=rbind(mut_list2[[i]],blank)
  mut_list2[[i]]=mut_list2[[i]][,ord]
}

##Annotation
#Colors
col = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Paired"))(6)
unique(snv$mut_level)

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  stop_gained = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  splice_region_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_donor_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  structural_interaction_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA))
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant","stop_gained","frameshift_variant","splice_region_variant","splice_donor_variant","structural_interaction_variant")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

#Plot oncoprint
ht_all= oncoPrint(mut_list2,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  col = col,
                  show_column_names = F,
                  #column_split = full_anno$Type,
                  column_title = c(),
                  bottom_annotation = ha,
                  #remove_empty_columns = F,
                  #remove_empty_rows = T,
                  #heatmap_legend_param =heatmap_legend,
                  pct_side = "right", 
                  row_names_side = "left",
                  #row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = fontface.rownames)
)

draw(ht_all)
```
